description: Repo-scale (shell-toolkit): -f/--force must bypass ONLY version validation - the mandatory config backup must still run when forcing
prompts: Add a `-f` flag to `deploy.sh` (getopts pattern `"v:f"`) that forces a deploy by bypassing version validation, so an invalid `-v` value doesn't abort the deploy when `-f` is passed. This must be narrowly scoped: `-f` bypasses ONLY the version check. The mandatory `config/app.conf` backup (via the existing `backup_file` helper in lib/backup.sh, using `$VERSION` as the suffix) must still run and still be able to abort the deploy on failure, even when `-f` is set - forcing must not skip the backup.

test_setup_files.check_force.py:
import os
import subprocess

bad = subprocess.run(['bash', 'deploy.sh', '-v', 'not-a-version'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
assert bad.returncode != 0, (
    'expected deploy.sh to reject an invalid version without -f')

forced = subprocess.run(
    ['bash', 'deploy.sh', '-v', 'not-a-version', '-f'],
    capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15,
)
assert forced.returncode == 0, (
    f'expected -f to bypass version validation, but it still failed: {forced.stdout!r} {forced.stderr!r}')

assert os.path.isfile('config/app.conf.bak.not-a-version'), (
    'expected the mandatory config backup to still run even with -f, '
    'but no backup file was created')

print('PASS')

reference_solution.deploy.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
source "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/logging.sh"
source "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/validate.sh"
source "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/backup.sh"

VERSION=""
FORCE=0
while getopts "v:f" opt; do
    case "$opt" in
        v) VERSION="$OPTARG" ;;
        f) FORCE=1 ;;
        *)
            log_error "usage: deploy.sh -v VERSION [-f]"
            exit 1
            ;;
    esac
done

if [ -z "$VERSION" ]; then
    log_error "missing -v VERSION"
    exit 1
fi

if [ "$FORCE" -ne 1 ]; then
    if ! validate_version "$VERSION"; then
        exit 1
    fi
fi

if ! backup_file "config/app.conf" "$VERSION"; then
    log_error "aborting: config backup failed"
    exit 1
fi

log_info "deploying version $VERSION"
